batting.name: AG Paunikar
batting.dismissal: c JH Kallis b Shakib Al Hasan

balls.text: short of a length outside off, Botha stays on the back foot and dabs towards the off side
Taylor tries to pull once again - does he have another shot? - and he can't make contact and gets hit on the body
Botha takes one hand off the bat as he too mis-times the pull, towards square leg though
short ball outside off, Taylor mis-times the pull towards long-on, reaches the fielder on the bounce
full ball that strays down leg side and beats Taylor and the keeper, costly error in execution from Lee
Taylor moves across his crease and mis-times the pull towards long-on, the throw from Yusuf is poor and allows the second. It was a long and loopy throw that went over the keeper.
short ball outside off stump, Botha mis-hits the pull towards square leg
full ball angling into Taylor who swings across the line and hits the ball powerfully towards wide long-on, he's placed it well enough to beat the man running to his right from long-on

a low full toss, Taylor gets under it and swings towards deep midwicket, the ball doesn't clear the boundary, it doesn't even reach the fielder on the full. It was the slower ball from Balaji. Taylor sprints back for two.
short and slow from Balaji, mis-timed towards mid-on for a single
Botha misses the glance off the hips and the ball hits his thigh and goes behind square, the keeper has to chase so they can run two
full ball angling into the right-hander, Taylor aims to heave over midwicket again but the length isn't right for the shot, he misses and gets hit on the pad
Botha plays a length ball from Balaji towards long-on
Botha pushes the ball towards cover off the back foot and sets off, even Lee can't get to the ball in time to cut it off
Botha moves back and across this time to pull through midwicket, he takes on Morgan and comes back for the second
short of a length outside off, Botha moves back and hits the ball hard towards cover where the fielder dives to his right and half stops the ball
short and wide outside off, Taylor cuts off the back foot towards deep point
Taylor can play on the off side too! He moves towards the off, and slaps a full ball from Lee past the fielder at mid off
jumps on the back foot and guides the ball behind point for a single
played towards long-on for a single
Botha tries to reverse-hit the ball immediately but can't beat short third man
bowled him! For once the slog sweep fails Watson. He wanted to hit another six but missed the ball. Shakib had turned it past the bat and hit the stumps
left-arm spinner to Watson, plants his foot forward, uses his long reach, raises his bat high and then swings it like a hammer, sending the ball over the deep midwicket boundary
that pitched way outside leg stump and beat Taylor's slog sweep, hitting him on the thigh
Watson reaches forward and slog-sweeps the ball powerfully towards cow corner, where there is a fielder

there's a deep square leg and a deep midwicket in place and Taylor splits the gap and hits it over the boundary. Balaji bowled him a full toss and that bat came down so hard and fast, giving the fielders no chance
a full ball angles into the right-hander and Taylor gets hit on the pad after missing the swing towards midwicket, Balaji appeals for lbw and that looked close
short once again but Watson can't do a Taylor, he pulls along the ground to the fielder on the square leg boundary
full delivery outside off stump, Taylor moves towards the line and drives to point
Taylor tries to heave a fuller ball on the leg side and gets beaten
Balaji cannot bowl that short at his pace to Taylor, he moves across his stumps and pulls the ball flat over the deep square leg boundary. He'll hit that all day, and night
driven off the front foot through cover
Taylor moves his front foot outside off to try and swing the ball towards leg, doesn't make contact
full ball on off stump, Taylor drives off the front foot towards deep cover, Watson charges back for the second. Rajasthan move past 100
played off the pads through square leg

driven off the front foot towards wide mid-off for a quick single, Watson dives to make his ground but would have been out had there been a direct hit at the bowler's end, Abdulla misses though and concedes overthrows
a bit of width outside off, Taylor guides it towards third man
Taylor plays the last ball on the leg side, doesn't make proper contact with the swat
Taylor moves towards the off and misses the swing off the pads, Shakib fires the ball marginally down leg, harsh call of wide
cut off the back foot towards short third man
there he goes! Watson lunges forward, picks up the ball from outside off, and slams it over the straight boundary. Lovely timing and such clean contact
a full toss outside off and Taylor moves towards the off and swats it towards deep midwicket
Watson lines him up but it's not a six! Watson reaches forward and lofts the ball flat towards long on
Taylor moves towards the off and then nudges the ball in the direction of midwicket
nudged off the front foot towards long on once again
Watson reaches forward and drives the ball towards long on
Watson moves forward and drives back to the bowler
played off the pads towards fine leg
played off the front foot towards mid-on
Watson strides forward and drives the ball to long-off
played off the back foot towards point

caught and bowled! Menaria backs away towards leg to smash the ball through the off, he ends up hitting it with the bottom of the bat and the ball flies right back at Yusuf, who takes the catch at head height
clumsy and shoddy cricket, Watson plays the ball back to Yusuf who throws the ball back at the keeper. It's a poor throw and there's a fumble, which allows overthrows
bowled! Dravid moves back and aims for the heave through the leg side, the ball was slow again and Dravid missed it by miles
that's such a slow ball and it's so short, Dravid moves back and can't beat cover entirely
Menaria moves back and forces the ball through wide mid-on
Dravid makes room and tries to flay the ball through the off, he doesn't make contact
played towards point with a quick single, direct hit at the bowler's end would have run him out
too full and too much on leg stump, Menaria plays a whippy glance to the fine leg boundary. A semblance of Yuvraj in that stroke
short of a length outside off, Menaria tries to cut but is beaten
dabbed towards point for a quick single, there's an overthrow at the non-striker's end
Dravid winds up to thrash Kallis down the ground but slices the ball in the air over the head of the fielder at point
it's taken a while but it's finally here, Menaria raises his bat high and tees off, lofting a full ball with immense power off the front foot over the midwicket boundary
Dravid steps out and flat-bats the ball down the ground, it's keeping low and slow
short ball and it keeps so low that it beats Dravid's attempted pull and misses leg stump
played off the back foot towards cover
Dravid moves forward, waits, and then works the ball behind square off his pads
cut off the back foot through point

Dravid had no pace to work with there, the ball was straight and came slowly off the pitch. He made a bit of room though and hit through the line off the front foot, lofting the ball over the bowler's head and timing it well enough to reach the boundary
short length and Menaria muscles the ball through midwicket
Dravid reaches out to heave the ball on the leg side but mis-times it
slow and straight, defended on the off side from the crease
forced down the ground towards long on
Dravid makes room to hit inside out through the off side but gets an outside edge that flies between the keeper and short third man
bowled full into the blockhole, driven back to the bowler
played towards long-on for one
short and straight, Dravid moves back, makes room and pulls through midwicket. Menaria hurries back for the second
played towards deep square leg for a single
this time he inside edges the attempted cut past his stumps
short ball outside off stump, bang. Menaria waits in his crease and cuts the ball behind point, beats the fielder on the backward point boundary
steered towards third man and Paunikar will keep strike.
good length on middle and off, played from the crease towards point
short of a length down leg side, another wide
driven all along the ground this time to long-on
dropped, Dravid leans forward once again to flick and this time he hits it to the fielder at midwicket, Tiwary was slow in moving forward and couldn't get to it in time
Dravid leans forward and across and flicks the ball in the air out of the reach of the fielder at midwicket, who dived to his left
full ball on the pads, flicked behind square and Morgan sprints towards the ball to cut off the second
short of a length and the ball once again doesn't come on to the bat, Dravid jumps on the back foot and plays towards the bowler
full and straight, driven to mid-on

Menaria gets squared up by a short of a length delivery and plays it on the off side, Dravid responds to the call for one and Lee sprints across to field, getting in Dravid's way. Raises a hand in apology after the run.
Dravid plays the ball off the back foot on the leg side, that came slowly off the pitch and Dravid had to adjust
fuller ball on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards mid-off
short ball and well-directed, Dravid stands tall and plays it down
Dravid goes deep into his crease and plays the ball off his pads through midwicket
that's too far down leg side
played towards point and Menaria is off the mark
played off the back foot towards point
caught at short third man. Paunikar charged and attempted to smash Shakib over midwicket. The pace was slower and he was hitting against the turn. The outside edge landed in Kallis' hands
played off the pads through square leg
played off the back foot towards the off side
Dravid waits in his crease, opens the face and steers a length ball towards third man
a slower short ball, Dravid plays the pull too early and makes no contact
good length and straight, Dravid gets behind the line and defends towards the bowler
that's short and it takes ages to arrive, relatively speaking, Paunikar was into the shot a bit early and ended up swatting it towards square leg. He was aiming for midwicket
Balaji angles the ball into the right-hander, Paunikar makes a bit of room and pushes towards point
Balaji gives Dravid some width and he plays the cut towards third man
good length outside off, defended on the front foot towards the off
good length and straight, defended back to the bowler
Paunikar waits a bit before cutting a length ball from Kallis behind point, he's placed it square enough to beat the fielder at third man
good length and straight, defended from the crease towards the bowler
tries to cut it this time but hits it too hard into the ground
wide again outside off, but close enough for Dravid to reach it and drive through cover for four
what's with all the wides today, another one far outside off stump. Kallis the villain this time
played towards point off the front foot
good length just outside off stump, defended towards point of the front foot
better length but still wide outside off, Paunikar fishes and catches nothing
short and wide outside off, Paunikar reaches out to slash it but misses
short ball and Balaji's pace is extremely gentle, Paunikar pulls off the front foot to the midwicket boundary
lots of width outside off but Paunikar can't find the gap at point, he reached out to cut the ball
that's too wide outside off, another extra to keep Rajasthan ticking
good length outside off, the batsman pushes at it but is beaten
that's a better line, on off and middle, Dravid defends off the front foot
fuller and wider outside off, Dravid reaches out for it and plays the square drive through the gap at point
good length and very straight, Dravid brings his bat down in time to defend on the off side
Dravid moves forward and defends a good length ball on the off side
fuller length with more swing this time into the batsman, the keeper fumbles the take after the batsman lets it go
very wide outside off and it swings away further, Bisla has to leap to his right to collect it
good length ball outside off stump with some swing away from the right-hander, Paunikar lets it go through to the wicketkeeper Bisla
and that's it. Game over. Gambhir raises his bat in celebration as he runs the single. Kallis drives off the front foot to long off to score the winning runs
driven on the up, but to the fielder at cover
too straight and Kallis works the ball off his pads towards fine leg, the scores are level
pushed off the from foot towards point
Gambhir moves back and cuts the ball from his stumps past point
shorter length and Kallis hits it to the man on the cover boundary
he's timed it well this time, Kallis lofts a quicker ball over the fielder at mid-on
Kallis tries to slug the ball over the leg side but mis-times it to midwicket
and Kallis drives the ball back to Warne
Gambhir stays on the back foot and tries to guide a short and slower ball towards third man, he didn't have the room to work with though and was beaten
pulled through midwicket for a single
this time he edges it to the third man boundary. Kallis tried to make room and drive through the off but his execution was poor, the result wasn't though
short ball, pulled away. Kallis stays in his crease and hits it extremely hard, placing it through midwicket
Kallis steps out, gets a bit cramped for room and drives towards cover point
Gambhir charges again but this time he chips it over the in-field at cover

Kallis steps out, gets to the pitch of this one and lofts it powerfully over the long-on boundary. Looks like Rajasthan's record of winning every time they've set a target of more than 145 is coming to an end
Gambhir steps out of his crease, doesn't get to the pitch of the ball, and hits it through midwicket
Kallis makes room and carves the ball in the air over cover point
makes room and drives towards cover
Gambhir inside the hit across the line past his stumps
Kallis drives off the front foot through cover point
played off the pads through midwicket
nudged off the pads towards fine leg

Gambhir has been caught on the deep midwicket boundary but the umpire has called no-ball because there were only three fielders in the circle, when there should have been four. Aleem Dar is on the ball and has spotted it. It was a short ball and Gambhir had pulled it flat and hard, straight to the fielder on the boundary. It's been given four as well, I'm not sure why. There's a lot of chat out there now. Botha realised it was no-ball, perhaps, and threw the ball towards bowler's end but everyone else was celebrating the wicket and no one collected the ball, which then went to the boundary
Kallis steps out and makes room to cut the ball towards deep point
Kallis steps out, sees the length and line isn't right to hit straight, and works the ball off his pads instead
Gambhir makes space to hit by moving his front foot out of the way and pulling through midwicket
the run machine reaches his third fifty of the tournament by driving to long-off, and this is his third innings
full ball and a bit too straight, Kallis flicks through square
short ball from round the wicket, Gambhir had moved towards the line and was cramped for room but still managed to pull towards deep square leg
Kallis waits in his crease and dabs the ball from outside off towards third man
Gambhir makes room once again by moving towards leg and drives a full ball from his stumps towards cover
Gambhir walks towards the off, works the ball off his pads towards square leg, and collects two more, easily
shot! Gambhir moves towards leg to make room, waits for the length ball to reach him from round the wicket and lofts it over extra cover
Gambhir steps forward, clears his front foot out of the way and tries to slam the ball over midwicket, he mis-times it
Kallis moves forward and gets inside the line once again to glance the ball off his thigh towards fine leg

Kallis moves forward and towards the off side to get inside the line and pull the ball behind square, the fielder from fine leg runs to his left and dives, he was touching the rope as he pulled the ball in
Kallis backs away towards leg to make the space to punch towards point
Kallis steps out, Trivedi bangs it in short, Kallis tries to hook, but makes no contact
Kallis steps out and drives the ball towards point, Warne has catchers at short cover and short midwicket
Kallis pushes forward at one and gets an outside edge towards backward point
Kallis makes room and tries to hit the ball a little too hard through cover, he mis-times it and hits it into the ground
Kallis moves forward and defends on the off side
played off the back foot towards cover
driven towards long-on for a single, Kolkata are walking this
terrific shot, Gambhir steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball and uses the room he's created to loft the ball over cover into the gap on the boundary
Kallis moves forward and pushes the ball off his pads towards wide long-on, they rush back for two before the fielder from long-on can get to the ball
Gambhir waits in his crease and slaps the short of a length ball through cover
Kallis plays the ball towards third man, that kept a touch low and Kallis had to work a bit harder
dabbed towards point off the front foot
Gambhir brings up fifty by working the ball off his pads through square leg, he's got there off 28 balls, it's been a fiery innings
short of a length with width outside off, Kallis drives the ball through point off the back foot
cut towards the fielder on the point boundary
Kallis tries to defend on the front foot but gets an edge that falls short of first slip
too short outside off stump from Warne, cut off the back foot through point
defended watchfully on the front foot this time
pulled to the man at square leg
Gambhir strides forward, gets down low and plays the slog sweep, he makes superb connection and hits the ball along the ground to the deep square boundary
nudged off the front foot towards the off side
Kallis moves forward and drives to long-on for a single
chipped in the air down the ground for a single
this time he gets it right, cutting off the back foot from close to off stump through the gap at backward point
Gambhir tries to cut but it's too close and he gets a bottom edge into the ground close to the stumps
driven off the front foot towards long on
that was the quicker and straighter one, Kallis plays off the back foot towards cover
Kallis pokes at one from his crease and gets beaten outside off, there's a slip in place
played behind point for a single, fuller ball
cracking shot, Gambhir moves back so quickly to make the space to cut, it was a touch short from Warne and the ball sped to the cover boundary
Kallis chips the drive intentionally in the air towards long-off, hitting it with the turn
Kallis welcomes Warne with a powerful drive through extra cover, Warne got that to turn
Kallis stays in his crease and flicks the ball behind square
Kallis moves forward and dabs the ball from outside off towards short third man
turned off the pads towards square leg
played behind point with an open face
Gambhir reaches for the ball on the front foot and chips it in the air towards long-off, falls well short of the fielder
Kallis moves forward and nudges the ball behind point
Gambhir charges, makes room by moving towards leg, and lofts the length ball over the fielder at mid-off
Gambhir tries to play the ball to third man but is beaten outside off
too far on leg stump and Gambhir glances it fine off his pads, easy runs these
another ball played in the air but through the packed off side field, Gambhir leans forward and drives the ball in the air towards point where Raut dives to his right and gets fingertips to it again
played off the pads in front of square
Gambhir charges and tries to slap a short of a length ball through a packed off side field, Taylor flies to his left at cover and gets finger tips to the airborne ball
driven back to the bowler off the front foot
Gambhir moves forward and works the ball towards square leg
Gambhir charges the left-arm spinner, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it with a full follow through, sending it high over the long-on boundary
driven towards cover off the front foot
Kallis makes a touch of room and aims for the booming drive through cover, the ball flies off the outside edge and just falls wide of the fielder at backward point, who dived to his right
nudged off the pads behind square
Watson's a bit too straight and Kallis works the ball off his pads behind square
flicked off the pads towards square leg
Gambhir moves forward and across to nudge the ball towards mid-on
Gambhir dabs the ball off the front foot towards point and wants one, Kallis doesn't.
full on leg stump once again, flicked off the pads to midwicket
Watson's first ball in this IPL is a half-volley on leg stump, Kallis dispatches it to the midwicket boundary with a drive off his pads
pushed towards cover for a single, it's a risky one but Kallis gets between the throw and the stumps and blocks it. Intentionally but unintentionally at the same time.
played towards mid-on
driven towards point off the front foot
and again, Kallis strides out, gets under the ball and lofts it cleanly over long-off. Menaria v Kallis, what a mismatch this is. Menaria's a part time left-arm spinner at best.
played off the front foot on the off side
Kallis steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits the harmless left-arm spinner right over his head
short and wide outside off, Gambhir steps out and slaps the ball through cover
played off the front foot towards midwicket
Gambhir moves forward and opens the face to play towards point
full ball outside off stump, driven off the front foot towards point

good length outside off stump, Kallis drives the ball towards extra cover and sets off for the single, the fielder at mid-off runs to his left, picks up and throws the ball to the wicketkeeper with Bisla miles out of his crease, the keeper fails to collect the ball as he breaks the stumps though, the ball seemed to have popped out of his gloves before he broke the stumps, the third umpire thinks otherwise, strange.
that's full and too far down leg side
short of a length delivery punched towards point
played back to the bowler
Bisla charges and tries to hit through the off but the ball hits the inside edge and goes on the leg side
pushed from the crease towards point
Menaria strays down leg side, Bisla misses the sweep and the ball thuds into the keeper's pads
short ball with some width outside off, Kallis moves back and cuts in front of point
Kallis strides forward and drives the ball through cover
bowled flat and straight from round the wicket, played off the back foot on the leg side
